sharinghistory.db.intro:
Dear Visitor,

The Database is designed for visitors with a specific interest in Sharing History and for visitors to the Permanent Collection who would like to know more about any item on display.

The Database has a guided search facility that lets you research a topic or look at items according to your individual interests or criteria.

Please enter the terms you wish to search for in the Keywords fields and define the category of the terms by using the options next to them.

sharinghistory.pc.text:
**Collections** offers two ways to explore the items in the *Sharing History* Database:

**If you select a Country,** you can see all the items that were contributed by the Partners from the selected country. You can then select by Theme and further select by Subtheme. All results will relate to the country you first selected.

**If you select a Theme,** the result will include the items that were contributed by all countries for that Theme only. Further selection by Subthemes is also available.

The Themes are those covered by our Exhibitions, but in Collections you can also see extra material that was not used for the Exhibitions.

The items are mostly listed in chronological order, within the period 1815 – 1918.

Enjoy your visit!
